reason: A weather-focused UI enhancement plugin that retrieves weather and approximate IP location data, applies weather-responsive themes and ambient effects, and provides interactive HUD, cards, audio, and pet elements.

summaries.zh: 根据天气数据为 DSH 界面应用动态主题、氛围效果、天气卡片、环境音效和交互式鲸鱼宠物。
summaries.en: Applies weather-responsive themes, ambient effects, weather cards, environmental sounds, and an interactive whale pet to the DSH interface.

capabilities: Uses IP-based geolocation with fallback providers
Applies UI theme tokens and full-screen ambient effects
Renders animated weather cards, HUD elements, and a whale pet
Generates environmental audio with Web Audio
Stores manual city overrides in localStorage
